messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.example.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.example.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example.com>

Date: 2026-07-08T16:12:00Z
Subject: Cross-functional launch readiness: Optimize Pro go-to-market sync

Team —

We're T-3 weeks from the Optimize Pro launch and I want a quick, cross-functional pulse ahead of tomorrow's exec QBR prep. Goal: surface any blockers that could impact launch KPIs (SLA, docs, training, pricing approval, support runbook).

Ask: please reply with a 1–3 line status and any open risks + owners. Specifics I'm looking for:
- GTM (Marissa): campaign + field enablement cadence, demo readiness, partner marketplace listing status
- Pricing (Rishi): final price bands, discount guardrails, approval for early adopters
- Docs (Laura): public docs + migration guide timing, key missing pages
- Support (Stephanie): playbooks, on-call coverage for week 1, escalation matrix

I attached a living checklist (Q3-launch-readiness-checklist.xlsx). I've added Emily from Acme on CC to keep the anchor customer looped for the pilot opt-in.

No need for long threads — bullets only. I'll consolidate for the QBR brief by EOD tomorrow.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of GTM Operations, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.example.com

Attachment: Q3-launch-readiness-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

Date: 2026-07-08T17:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Cross-functional launch readiness: Optimize Pro go-to-market sync

Jonas —
- GTM status: Campaign creative and landing page live in staging; field enablement slide deck 90% complete. Demo flows validated with product team (recorded 3x).
- Risk: Marketplace listing (CloudMarket) requires a security artifact that we don't currently have in the repo; working with partnerships to expedite. Owner: Marissa (ETA: 7/13).
- Action: Need 2 customer-facing demo scripts reviewed by Product by 7/10.

I'll sync with partners thread and update the checklist.

-Marissa

Subject: Re: Cross-functional launch readiness: Optimize Pro go-to-market sync

Jonas / team —
- Pricing: Final price bands approved by finance yesterday. See attached PDF for the published tier table (OptimizePro_pricing_v1.pdf).
- Risk: Early-adopter discount window needs legal sign-off for the terms sheet; finance ok but legal wants one clause clarified (data retention liability). Owner: Rishi / Legal (ETA: 7/12).
- Quick ask: confirm if Acme will require a custom SLA; Emily, can you confirm in this thread?

Thanks,
Rishi

Jonas —
- Docs: Public docs for core workflows (install, quickstart, API reference) are on track for 7/14. Migration guide for existing customers will be a separate playbook targeted for 7/20.
- Risk: Two missing snippets for the API reference (streaming examples and function-calling sample). Owner: Laura + eng doc pair. ETA: 7/11 for drafts.
- Link: docs-status-summary.md (I exported a short status file to Drive) — https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cOptimizeProDrive

I'll aim to provide the finalized quickstart by 7/14 EOD so marketing can pull snippets.

Thanks,

Subject: Re: Cross-functional launch readiness: Optimize Pro go-to-market sync

Thanks for the quick updates — this is perfect. Consolidated next steps (short owners + due dates):
- Market listing security artifact: Marissa / Partnerships — 2026-07-13
- Demo script reviews: Product + Marissa — 2026-07-10
- Legal review for early-adopter term: Rishi / Legal — 2026-07-12
- Docs API snippets: Laura / Eng — 2026-07-11
- Support runbooks & on-call plan: Stephanie — 2026-07-14 (please include burn-in on-call for week 1)

I updated the checklist (see attached) and will fold these items into the QBR brief. Emily — if Acme needs a custom SLA, please flag ASAP; we'll treat as a prioritization decision.

If nobody objects, I'll mark the launch readiness as "on-track with blockers" in the QBR deck and surface the two legal/marketplace blockers for exec attention.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber | Head of GTM Operations
